did: Built the interview week on the phone (IW5). It lives in Jobs as a fourth view, Interview: a brief with the invented company and role, a card per question and per teleprompter read, one spoken take each of at most two minutes, a look over, then Send. A read shows its script large, counts down three seconds, then records with the script still on screen. Takes go home as interview voice notes, and the week can be sent again until its deadline, when what home holds is final. The weeks come from home and the sends go home through the Jobs lane. Instead of copying Rust Rounds, the week's draft and send stores and its date helpers now live once in voice-capture and core-utils, and Rust Rounds uses them too. On the way, it fixed a limits-test failure that main picked up from #3060.

calls.title: Where the interview week lives in the app (C396)
options: The Jobs wing, as a fourth view
calls.why: The issue named Jobs as fitting, since interview is already a stage there, but Practice holds Rust Rounds, whose template this follows, so either reads naturally on the phone.
calls.undo: Move the route under Practice or a new wing, and give its exchange a lane of its own instead of the Jobs lane.

calls.title: How long a read counts down before it records (C397)
options: Three seconds, called off by any other action
calls.why: The issue asked for a short countdown and named no length; how long you want to settle before reading aloud is a preference you notice every time.
calls.undo: Change CUE_SECONDS in the interview week's cue module.

left: The screen doesn't show what home heard in a take, as Rust Rounds' week does; the issue didn't ask for it.
No Let go on the screen, so MarkFrom wasn't extended.

CI tests only the packages a PR changes and their dependents, so a packages/ui workspace www doesn't depend on can still add a limit-like constant that www's limits test only catches after merge, as #3060 did. Filed by the coordinator as #3062.
